title: Spaces before and after the number and description are removed on save
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Use a part number for a new part, part A, that no part or Part Library entry uses yet.
  • Start on the Inventory page (Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu), on the Active tab.
custom_steps:
1. Click New Inventory Part.
  2. Type three spaces, then part A's description, then three spaces, in the Description field.
  3. Type three spaces, then part A's part number, then three spaces, in the Part Number field.
  4. Pick any category in the Category field.
  5. Type 10.00 in the Cost field.
  6. Click Save.
  7. Type part A's part number in the Search box.
  8. Click the part A row.
  9. Click at the very end of the Part Number text.
  10. Press Backspace.
  11. Click Cancel.
  12. Click Part Library in the left menu.
  13. Type part A's part number in the Search box.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The New Inventory Part window opens.

Step 2:

  • Description holds the spaces and the text.

Step 3:

  • Part Number holds the spaces and the number.

Step 4:

  • The category shows in the Category field.

Step 5:

  • Cost reads $10.00.

Step 6:

  • The window closes and the part is saved.

Step 7:

  • One row shows part A's description and part number with no spaces before or after them.

Step 8:

  • Edit Inventory Part opens with Description and Part Number holding the text with no spaces before or after it.

Step 9:

  • The cursor sits right after the last character of the part number.

Step 10:

  • Backspace removes the last character of the part number, which shows no space was kept at the end.

Step 11:

  • The window closes without saving.

Step 12:

  • The Part Library page opens.

Step 13:

  • The entry for part A shows its part number and description with no spaces around them.
